summary.result: The results suggest that the reflectance properties of soils are related to soil color, soil texture, and soil moisture.
summary.background: Recent advances in remote sensing techniques provide the potential for monitoring soil color as well as soil moisture conditions at the spatial and temporal scales required for detailed local modeling efforts.
summary.method: We evaluate the influence of seven soil properties, soil color and soil moisture, on soil spectral reflectance.
